messages.subject: bimodal percent CpG methylation
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I was wondering if there were any standardized metrics for the percent CpG methylation graphs. In my graphs I do see a somewhat bimodal formation though they have a heavy trend towards being methylated rather than an equal distribution between methylated and unmethylated. These are human blood samples and we know that a large part should be in the methylated state, but should the bimodal graph look like this or is there an issue with my data? (image below)
Thanks

Christina
